description: Local-only historical response Artifact recompute through real Server, daemon, same-class Executors, Resource, ledger, and non-root MySQL.
correctness_gates: a normal user previews and confirms the exact immutable historical Backfill
every response Artifact is read through an Atoll File Resource by a real daemon-hosted recruiting-executor
every frozen Detail Recipe execution writes one derived Artifact and one BackfillOutput
input and derived Resource bytes match their MySQL SHA-256 metadata

Backfill item, Attempt, output, and Artifact counts exactly match the workload; initial dispatches are compacted to one per selected Executor and each completed Attempt emits one capacity-release wake
all domain event intents reach the Atoll Channel ledger before measurement
Server restart preserves completed Backfill state, byte-stable command replay, Executor presence, and Resource reads
non_claims: this measures local immutable response reads and real derived Artifact writes, not HTTP or Browser response capture
this does not measure a remote object store or wide-area network
A0/A1/A2 do not substitute for 20K Listing plus 400K Detail daily execution completion or long-window SLO
